{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = "/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv"
sales = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue_clean'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter out QA orders (revenue == 999999.99)
non_qa_sales = sales[sales['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99]

# Filter for completed orders only
completed_orders = non_qa_sales[non_qa_sales['status'] == 'completed']

# Compute mean revenue of completed orders
mean_revenue_completed = completed_orders['revenue_clean'].mean()

# Output the result
print(f"Mean revenue of completed orders (after removing QA orders): {mean_revenue_completed}")"}
